feature: The forms of /GitProtect set, lift or show the protection of a branch; help stops before any inspection and a wrong combination executes nothing

also: a detached HEAD without a branch

expected: The usage line and the argument hint list every option: /GitProtect [<branch>] [--release | --status] [--lang <language>] [--help].
Without a branch the command takes git branch --show-current, and a detached HEAD stops it and asks for a branch name; a branch that does not exist yet can be protected.

--help (and --lang) is handled first: the command shows its inline help and stops before any tool call; an unknown option, more than one branch or --release with --status is a usage error that executes nothing.
--status runs only the read-only guard subcommand protect-show; setting and lifting run the user-only subcommand protect.

contains: Handle `--help` first, even if other arguments are present.
For an unknown option, more than one branch, or `--release` together with `--status`, explain the error, show this help, and stop.
a detached HEAD stops the command and asks for a branch name
A branch that does not exist yet can be protected: the name is what is stored.
- `--status`: Read-only: print the protections of the repository (`magos_guard.py protect-show`); nothing is written and nothing is approved.
If `--help` is present, even with other arguments, answer from the inline Usage section above and stop before any tool call, file read, or repository inspection.
a detached HEAD stops the command and asks for a branch name
`--release` together with `--status`, more than one branch, or an unknown option is a usage error: explain it, show the usage, and execute nothing.
